scripts.dev: node scripts/write-version.js && concurrently "npm run css:watch" "npm run hugo:dev"
scripts.build: node scripts/write-version.js && tailwindcss -i site/assets/css/input.css -o site/static/css/style.css --minify && hugo --source site --config hugo.toml --minify
scripts.admin:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev site/public --r2 ASSETS_BUCKET=ctsmith-blog-assets --r2 ORIGINALS_BUCKET=ctsmith-blog-originals
